ui.teamBridge.page.title.tone: sentence case, product name kept as-is
ui.teamBridge.page.title.note: The page's name. "Team Bridge" is the product surface name — never translate the words separately, they name one feature.

ui.teamBridge.page.subtitle.note: Says who the user talks to here: teammates and their agents. "Agent" is the product noun.

ui.teamBridge.page.new_conversation.note: Opens the create dialog. Used for DMs, groups and channels alike, so it must not say "channel".

ui.teamBridge.list.empty.title.note: Shown when the account has no conversations at all. States the fact, does not apologise.

ui.teamBridge.list.empty.body.note: Names the three things the user can start. Keep the three nouns parallel.

ui.teamBridge.list.loading.note: Announced while the conversation list loads; also the accessible label of the loading spinner.

ui.teamBridge.list.error.note: Shown when the list read fails (backend down, signed out or an upstream refusal). Do not name a cause the client cannot prove.

ui.teamBridge.list.untitled.note: Used when a group or channel has no name. A DM always has a derived title, so this is never shown for one.

ui.teamBridge.kind.dm.note: One-to-one conversation. The abbreviation is standard but spell it out for translation.

ui.teamBridge.kind.group.note: A named conversation with a few members.

ui.teamBridge.kind.channel.note: An organization-visible or private room. Keep distinct from "group".

ui.teamBridge.thread.loading.note: Announced while one conversation's messages load.

ui.teamBridge.thread.error.note: Shown when the message history read fails. The list beside it stays usable.

ui.teamBridge.thread.empty.note: A conversation with no messages. Invites the first message without exclamation.

ui.teamBridge.composer.placeholder.note: The composer sits at the bottom of the thread; the placeholder names the act, not the conversation.

ui.teamBridge.composer.send.note: Accessible name of the send control. It must work as a button name on its own.

ui.teamBridge.composer.hint.note: Names both key gestures. Key names stay untranslated; only "to send" and "for a new line" are copy.

ui.teamBridge.member.agent.note: Marks a participant whose messages come from an agent rather than a person. Product noun.

ui.teamBridge.member.invited.note: A human invited to the conversation who has not joined yet. An invited agent is never shown to other members, so this is human-only in practice.

ui.teamBridge.nav.label.note: The row inside the sidebar's More group. Same name as the page heading; never abbreviate in the row.

ui.teamBridge.nav.unread.role: sidebar row accessible name with unread count

placeholders.count: unread message count; a positive integer

ui.teamBridge.nav.unread.note: The name carries the number because a badge is only a visual convenience. Plural forms matter. The collapsed row uses this same name through its tooltip.

ui.teamBridge.create.title.note: Heading of the dialog that starts a DM, group or channel.

ui.teamBridge.create.name.note: Optional name for a group or channel. DMs are not named.

ui.teamBridge.create.members.note: The list of people (or their agents) to include.

ui.teamBridge.create.cancel.note: Closes the dialog without creating anything.

ui.teamBridge.create.confirm.note: Creates the conversation. Disabled until the form is valid.

placeholders.count: unread message count; a positive integer

ui.teamBridge.unread.count.note: Short badge text beside a conversation row. Plural forms matter; keep it short so the row does not wrap.

ui.teamBridge.member.count.role: participant count in the thread header

placeholders.count: number of participants; a positive integer

ui.teamBridge.member.count.note: Sits beside the conversation title. Plural forms matter.

ui.teamBridge.create.member_account.note: The organization account id of the person or agent to include. Shown because the app has no directory picker yet; the label is technical on purpose.

ui.teamBridge.create.member_name.note: The name other members will see. This is the only name that crosses the wire, so it is required rather than derived.

ui.teamBridge.create.member_kind.note: Chooses whether the row names a person or an agent.

ui.teamBridge.create.member_person.note: A human member. Keep distinct from the product noun 'Agent'.

ui.teamBridge.create.member_agent.note: An agent member. Product noun, same capitalization as elsewhere.

ui.teamBridge.create.remove_member.note: Removes one row from the create form. Must work as a button name on its own.

ui.teamBridge.create.add_member.note: Appends one empty member row to the form.

ui.teamBridge.create.account_placeholder.note: An example account id prefix. The ellipsis is part of the example; keep the 'acct_' prefix untranslated.

ui.teamBridge.group.more.note: The collapsed group that holds low-frequency destinations. The Team Bridge row lives inside it, and its unread badge rides the group row while collapsed.

ui.teamBridge.thread.withheld.note: An agent member's message the agent has not admitted yet. It is a state, not an error; never imply the sender did something wrong.

ui.teamBridge.composer.error.note: A send that failed. Keep the draft on screen; this line explains why nothing was posted and invites a retry.

ui.teamBridge.create.error.note: Conversation creation failed. The dialog stays open with the form intact so the user can retry.

ui.teamBridge.scope.label.note: Names what the dropdown chooses. It is a visible section label inside the menu and also the trigger's accessible-name prefix.

ui.teamBridge.scope.all.note: The account-wide scope. It must read as every organization the person belongs to, never as a single organization.

placeholders.name: the current organization name or the all-organizations label

ui.teamBridge.scope.trigger.note: The trigger already shows `name` visually; this template is its accessible name, so screen-reader and visual state cannot disagree.

ui.teamBridge.scope.loading.note: The memberships read's first paint, shown inside the open menu rather than replacing the list.

ui.teamBridge.scope.error.note: The membership read failed. The switcher still shows the current scope; this line says why the other organizations are missing.

ui.teamBridge.scope.empty.note: The account holds no active memberships. Keep it distinct from the error copy.

ui.teamBridge.scope.unknown.note: A scope or row whose organization is not in the memberships read. A rare race, not a user error.

ui.teamBridge.scope.thread_unknown.note: A conversation from the merged list whose organization could not be resolved. The thread is withheld rather than shown under the wrong organization.

ui.teamBridge.scope.create_needs_org.note: Explains why New conversation is disabled while the account-wide scope is selected: a conversation must belong to exactly one organization.
